Configure Tesseract OCR for an English PNG image

```swift title="Swift"
import Xberg

let result = try await Xberg.extract("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"image/png\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/images/test_hello_world.png\"}", "{\"ocr\":{\"backend\":\"tesseract\",\"enabled\":true,\"language\":[\"eng\"],\"tesseract_config\":{\"psm\":6}}}")
debugPrint(result.results()[0].content())
```
